description: PURE FUNCTION enrichment module. Exposes EXACTLY: def compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict]. This is the FOUNDATION OF THE RUG-PULL SIGNAL (Signal 5 from the 7-signal trust framework -- the most unique signal because almost nobody runs continuous temporal-drift detection on MCPs). Reads MULTIPLE metadata fields: metadata.get('time_created', ''), metadata.get('time_modified', ''), metadata.get('first_seen', ''), metadata.get('last_seen', ''), metadata.get('version', ''), metadata.get('dependency_count', 0), metadata.get('age_days', None). Imports stdlib only: datetime (timezone, datetime), re. Helper _parse_iso(s) -> datetime|None: try datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z', '+00:00')) wrapped in try/except returning None on any failure. Compute: now = datetime.now(timezone.utc). created = _parse_iso(time_created) or _parse_iso(first_seen). modified = _parse_iso(time_modified) or _parse_iso(last_seen). If both None -> return (50.0, {'reason': 'no_temporal_data'}). Compute age_days = (now - created).days if created else None. Compute days_since_update = (now - modified).days if modified else None. Scoring rules (start at 60.0): (1) age_days < 7 -> -30 (brand new, unestablished); 7-30 -> -10; 30-180 -> 0; 180-365 -> +10 (proven); >365 -> +15 (long-established). (2) days_since_update < 7 -> 0 (active maintenance); 7-90 -> +5 (steady); 90-365 -> -5 (stagnating); >365 -> -15 (abandoned). (3) Pre-stable version: version starts with '0.' (regex match r'^0\.') -> -10. (4) Recent breaking change: version is X.0.0 with X >= 2 (regex match r'^([2-9]|\d{2,})\.0\.0$') AND days_since_update < 30 -> -20 (recent major bump = rug-pull breaking-change risk). (5) age_days > 365 AND days_since_update > 365 -> additional -10 (long-abandoned). Clamp [0.0, 100.0]. Returns (score, evidence_dict). Evidence dict: {'created_iso': str|None, 'modified_iso': str|None, 'age_days': int|None, 'days_since_update': int|None, 'version': str, 'penalty_breakdown': [{'rule': str, 'delta': float}, ...], 'final_score': float, 'metadata_fields_read': [...]}. CONSTRAINTS: NO DB writes, NO network, NO file I/O, NO project imports. Stdlib only. Under 2s. NO __main__ block. NOTE in module docstring: future iterations will add hash-vs-prior-fingerprint comparison once mcp_fingerprints accumulates multi-row history per server, enabling true rug-pull detection by drift in tool definitions.
